youth-ministry.title: Youth Ministry
youth-ministry.content:
Add Youth Ministry informationOur middle and high school students will be going to Crossing Camp in July.  In order to help with the cost of camp this year, we will have our final walk through breakfast fundraiser on Sunday April 12th at 9:45 am in the foyer. 

During the breakfast we will be accepting donations which will go towards the cost of the camp for each student.  

We are in need of breakfast items and if you are able to help with the food donations, please click the link below to sign up to bring one or more items. The theme for breakfast is, "The Waffle House."  

https://www.signupgenius.com/go/5080448ACAF2BA4FE3-62519851-youth#/ here.
